page.title: Branching and merging
page.desc: Diverge to work in isolation, then merge: three-way merges find the common ancestor, conflicts are where both sides changed the same lines.
page.intro: Diverge to work in isolation, then merge: three-way merges find the common ancestor, conflicts are where both sides changed the same lines.

synapses.text: Git compares both branch tips with their merge base; non-overlapping changes merge automatically.
Short-lived branches merged daily keep integration pain small; long-lived ones accumulate conflicts.
